* Add-Ons 1.13: Crystal refinery perk. Convert as follows per cycle:
* Up to 60 crystals -> 12 red crystal
* 3 red mineral -> 2 red crystal
* 1 orange mineral -> 2 red crystal
* 3 purple mineral -> 2 yellow crystal
* 2 blue mineral -> 3 yellow crystal
* 1 green mineral -> 1 blue crystal
* 1 silver mineral -> 2 blue crystal
* 1 gold mineral -> 1 green crystal
* 1 white mineral -> 2 green crystal
* *** Part A: Regular crystals -> red crystals. Up to 60 regular crystals -> 12 red crystals per cycle. ***
* *** Part B: colored minerals -> colored crystals. One recipe max per mineral type per cycle. ***
* 3 red mineral -> 2 red crystal
* 1 orange mineral -> 2 red crystal
* 3 purple mineral -> 2 yellow crystal
* 2 blue mineral -> 3 yellow crystal
* 1 green mineral -> 1 blue crystal
* 1 silver mineral -> 2 blue crystal
* 1 gold mineral -> 1 green crystal
* 1 white mineral -> 2 green crystal
* Add-Ons 2.0: New Jump Hole Generator perk.
* After setting the jump hole information in Menu.DWM.Set.Production.Station, the Outpost task assumes responsibility of jump hole generation and cleanup.
* 1. Retrieve the timer. When the timer (JHActivationTimer) passes:
* 2. Spawn the jump hole at this sector and at the destination sector (local var JHTargetSector). Assign the jump holes as variables to this Outpost.
* 3. Clear the timer local variable.
* 4. Maintain the jump hole connection for 6 hours (10 minutes in debug mode).
* 5. On cleanup:
* - Display effect 46 from the jump holes.
* - Destroy the jump holes and set the variables to null.
* - Set JHActive to FALSE.
* - Set the destination sector's mutex to 0 and clear this outpost's destination sector (set JHTargetSector to null).
* Check every 5 minutes. 10 minutes is too long as it will result in a missed window of up to 40 minutes! This means the jump hole activates 30-35min.
* Check if the Outpost is ready to spawn the jump hole pair. This timer is the pending spawn timer.
* Spawn the jump holes. 6 hour lifetime (10 minutes in debug mode). The gate creator script assigns the JH local vars to the Outpost.
* If gate creation fails (should never happen), clean all variables up.
* Set expiration timer.
* Check if the Outpost is ready to despawn the jump hole pair. This timer is the cleanup timer.
* Despawn the jump holes.
* Loop.

* Never use more reserve ships than this order requires.
* Only the non-reserve ships need to be paid for.
